name: mcpe-amazing-race
description: Minecraft Bedrock add-on: The Amazing Race for teams, run by one host.

scripts.test: node scripts/clean.mjs build/test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "build/test/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.coverage: node scripts/clean.mjs build/test build/coverage && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && c8 node --test "build/test/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.package: node scripts/clean.mjs behavior_pack/scripts && npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
